open_questions: Gulistan and Gulistan-Coach both point to https://mnzil.app/vehicles/Gulistan; Sheraz and Sheraz-Coach both point to https://mnzil.app/vehicles/Shiraz. Mnzil has one page per name, so the coach variants may run a different alignment.
Mnzil coordinates come from the app's own station table (stationsData in the page). They are not OSM or Wikipedia, so SCHEMA.md would have them re-geocoded; they are kept here only as a reference.
Mnzil pages give no dates or directions; the listed order is the one on the page and may be either direction.
